tex_content.label: distancedist
tex_content.html:
(cf. Lemma I.8.3(b)) If $d_{t_0}(x_0,x_1)\ge 2r_0$ and $\Ric (x,t_0)\le (n-1)K$ on the endpoint $r_0$-balls, then \begin{equation} {d\over dt}\dist _t(x_0,x_1)\big|_{t_0}\ge -2(n-1)\left({2\over 3}Kr_0+r_0^{-1}\right). \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch Apply the second variation formula to the piecewise-linear endpoint cutoff field $V_i=f e_i$, with $f=s/r_0$, $1$, and $(d-s)/r_0$ on the three subintervals; $\int |\nabla _XV_i|^2=2/r_0$ and the endpoint curvature terms contribute at most $2(n-1)K(2r_0/3)$.

□
Corollary
[estimates for length distortion estimates]
